$comment: Self-heal limits, declared once and read by everyone who asserts them. The skill-note length lived as a literal in _skill_note_format_ok and as prose in three prompt templates — and the ONE place that could have prevented the failure, the failure-analyst's own contract, did not state it at all. So the analyst wrote past the limit, the reviewer rejected on length and a summarizer rewrote: a full model round trip per attempt, costing both lanes about three of their twelve attempts on 2026-08-18.

skillNote.$why: A skill note is injected into a retry prompt and can persist into an agent's profile. Long notes crowd out the evidence the retry actually needs, and a paragraph is not an instruction. The producer is told this number so it writes within it, rather than discovering it as a rejection — the same contract the roster's rationale minimum already follows.
